fixtures.note: marker script appends one line per real process invocation to <child_root>/fixtures/invocations.log (independent business-effect counter)

onetime.timezone_note: sc-onetime-future uses timezone Asia/Shanghai with a UTC run_at; a timezone bug would shift the fire instant by 8h

retry.note: retry loop has no configured backoff (agent/agent.go retries immediately); observed attempt intervals are recorded as observations only - there is no normative threshold

source_findings.task_runner: internal/agent/execution/runner.go builds every command/script with SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true} and kills -pgid (SIGTERM, 2s, SIGKILL) regardless of deployment mode; there is no docker/compose-specific execution branch.
source_findings.enrollment_snippet_only: internal/hub/api/api.go returns docker_run/docker_compose snippets for enrolling the Agent itself (agent deployment), not for executing tasks.
source_findings.app_deploy: internal/agent/application.go deploys via systemd units through the host adapter, not docker compose.

docker.conclusion: No docker/compose *execution* form exists in the product; the process-group cleanup code path is shared and was exercised on the native owned child (phase6). The Docker/Compose sub-dimension is therefore PARTIAL.
